gaps.explanation: The budget schedules include 'Sale of surplus' in receipts; the governmental funds statement (p4) prints it under Other Financing Sources (General 3,131 + Road 45,902 = 49,033). p8 General Fund budget schedule receipts 4,983,381 vs p5 General Fund column 4,980,250 (+3,131: Intergovernmental 733,328 vs 728,773 and Local 850,478 vs 851,902); p9 Road Fund budget schedule Intergovernmental 1,690,992 + Local 53,778 = 1,744,770 vs p4 Road Fund receipts 1,698,868 (+45,902). Schedule 7,558,477 - statement 7,509,444 = 49,033 = 3,131 + 45,902. Nothing missing or duplicated.

p4 statement Transfers - in 1,356,525 = General 107,483 + Road 1,249,042. Detail also records the transfers among the General Fund sub-funds from the p5 combining page: Emergency Management 'Transfers - in' 40,000 and Noxious Weed 133,711 (printed positive in the Transfers - out row), which the p4 General Fund column nets (p5 Total General Fund: in 147,483, out (1,265,736)). Detail 1,530,236 - statement 1,356,525 = 173,711 = 40,000 + 133,711. Gross per fund vs net column; no line missing or duplicated.

p4 statement Transfers - out (1,356,525) = General (1,225,736) + Non-Major (130,789). Detail: General -799,447 (p8) + Inheritance Tax Fund -600,000 (p5) + Non-Major -144 - 107,339 - 23,306 (= 130,789, pp6-7) = 1,530,236. The p4 General Fund column nets the 173,711 transferred to Emergency Management (40,000) and Noxious Weed (133,711) inside the General Fund: 799,447 + 600,000 - 173,711 = 1,225,736. Detail 1,530,236 - 1,356,525 = 173,711. Presentation difference only.
